_comment: Per-task-type prep/response seconds. Config-driven (not hardcoded), matching authoring's task-skill-mapping.json pattern. TaskTimingConfig.timingFor() fails fast with TaskTimingNotConfiguredException when a task type is missing. All 23 current task types are listed. Existing values remain approximate placeholders pending official Pearson candidate-handbook sourcing. The 7 Listening types added in Phase 4 of plans/quang-listening-contract-and-timing on 2026-09-12 are TEMPORARY NON-PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDERS: they only prevent missing-config failures during snapshot pinning/demo and must not ship as production timing until timing semantics and values are verified. SUMMARIZE_SPOKEN_TEXT: temporary 600s response placeholder based on a secondary estimate, not an official production value. MC_LISTENING_MULTIPLE: temporary 20s response placeholder; any audio-duration range is context only. FILL_BLANKS_LISTENING: temporary 60s response placeholder; audio-duration range is context only. HIGHLIGHT_CORRECT_SUMMARY: temporary 20s response placeholder; audio-duration range is context only. SELECT_MISSING_WORD: temporary 20s response placeholder; audio-duration range is context only. HIGHLIGHT_INCORRECT_WORDS: temporary 30s response placeholder; audio-duration range is context only. WRITE_FROM_DICTATION: temporary 30s response placeholder; audio-duration range is context only. Do NOT infer a prep/response split from an audio range. The 5 audio-prompt Speaking types below additionally carry preListenSeconds/preRecordSeconds (plans/phat-speaking-dynamic-prep-timing); their own prepSeconds value stops being consulted once a real audioPromptRef is present because SnapshotPinService computes prepSeconds dynamically. Listening types do not use that dynamic branch.
